messages:
sam: Quick check — onboarding `orca-mini-3b` config hit CI. Where are the final weights/manifest? I see a placeholder s3 path.

jules: We pushed weights to s3://redwood-models/onnx/orca-mini-3b/20260314/, manifest is there. CI failing because `tokenizer.type` is "sentencepiece" but config missing `spm_model` path.

mia: Yeah the validator expects `tokenizer.spm_model` for sentencepiece. We changed defaults earlier to require `tokenizer.path` instead of `spm_model` — mismatch.

sam: Ah. So two competing schema versions. Which side should we change? I can update the model repo or the validator.

liz: Prefer updating validator to accept both fields (backcompat). Add a `tokenizer_aliases` mapping in validator schema. Also note max_seq default is 2048 for this model.

jules: Also watch tokenizer special tokens — this model uses BOS-only not CLS/SEP. Validator currently enforces `cls_token` existence.

sam: Oof. That's the error shown in CI:

```
ERROR: config-validator - missing required field `tokenizer.cls_token` for model orca-mini-3b
```

infra-bot: CI job 5027 on branch `model-onboard/orca-mini` failed — lint-config step. Link: https://ci.redwood.dev/5027

mia: Proposed quick patch: validator accepts optional `cls_token` if `tokenizer.type == \"sentencepiece\" && tokenizer.model_has_bos == true` or alternatively allow `bos_token` to satisfy cls requirement.

jules: I'm +1 for allowing `bos_token` alias. Simpler.

sam: I'll open PR to validator: add aliases and check both keys, plus accept either `spm_model` or `path`. PR #402.

liz: I'll review. Also add a unit test for the BOS-only case and a fixture using the s3 manifest path.

sam: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/config-validator/pull/402 — pinging @liz @jules for review :raised_hands:

jules: Reviewing now. small nit about error message wording.

mia: Leaving a comment in PR about updating onboarding docs (weights path examples) — we should standardize on manifest.json in the root.

sam: Cool. If we merge validator change we can retrigger CI and unblock dedicated rollout. Thanks :thumbsup:

infra-bot: CI retriggered for job 5027 — lint-config step queued.

liz: Approved PR, left two small comments. I'll merge after tests.

sam: TY! Will wait for merge then re-run.

jules: Also file follow-up to consolidate schema versions — ticket INF-1284.

sam: Ack. Adding to roadmap. End.
